subject: 辽金北方（11–13世纪）·净宽6格城门（原创扩展；匿名年代意象，非文物复原）

Two changes are required. 1. The side ground edge rising to the right is too shallow. Reproject the whole gate so BOTH long facade and short side ground edges have EXACTLY EQUAL slope magnitudes 0.5. In image coordinates long facade runs down-right (2 across,1 down); side depth runs up-right (2 across,1 up). Keep world verticals upright. No perspective. The physical rectangular plan is10front width by4depth, giving horizontal facade/depth runs exactly2.5. Move the back-right masonry foot UP so its diagonal matches the other axis; carry this steeper depth direction through both piers, roof, side walls and railings. For a1254square canvas, desired real masonry feet LEFT(65,770), FRONT(855,1165), RIGHT(1171,1007), hiddenBACK(381,612). These are invisible construction points, never draw outlines, labels or geometry guides.
2. LEFT pier is too broad on the facade. NARROW its front face to match the right pier by moving its inner front foot from about(256,911) to(223,849). Exact front sequence2units solid / 6units EMPTY / 2units solid. Full width10, clear opening6, each rectangular pier2wide by4deep. Left inner foot(223,849); right inner foot(697,1086). Thus the opening is exactly60percent of total front span. No broad flared pier bottoms. Piers should have straight vertical sides, all base corners crisp and on same ground plane.
Keep complete roof and all feet inside image with clear transparency margins. Keep the gate airy: passage completely open, alpha0 all the way beneath timber lintel and between the two piers; no floor, stair, base island, platform, door, additional wall or background. Sober ancient northern original game sprite, no people, letters, labels, watermark, modern items or checkerboard. Preserve realistic fine texture; only correct the above geometry.
